meta.title: H2H Finance
meta.description: Budget, spending and reimbursements for Heart to Heart, a student charity at YK Pao School.

login.title: Sign in
login.emailPrompt: Enter your email and we'll send you a sign-in code.
login.resent: A new code is on its way.
login.inviteOnly: Only invited members can sign in. If you're in the club and don't get a code, ask the club lead to add your email.

errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a while and try again.
errors.send_failed: We couldn't send the email. Try again in a minute.
errors.invalid_code: That code is wrong or has expired.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noBudget: No budget set for this year
dashboard.owedHint: Approved expenses members paid for themselves.
dashboard.noYearAdmin: Set up this year's budget to start tracking spending.
dashboard.noYearMember: The club lead hasn't set up this year's budget yet.

errors.invalid: Some details aren't valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.rate_limited: That's a lot in a short time. Wait a little and try again.
errors.no_year: No budget year covers that date. Ask the club lead to set one up.
errors.locked: This has already been reviewed and can't be changed.
errors.file_missing: A screenshot is missing or was already used. Upload it again.
errors.inactive_option: That category or event is no longer available.
errors.email_taken: Someone with that email is already a member.
errors.last_admin: The club needs at least one admin.
errors.overlapping_year: These dates overlap another budget year.

admin.title: Admin
admin.description: Budget, members and the options people choose from.

years.title: Budget years
years.description: Each expense counts towards the year its date falls in.
years.dialogHint: Changes to the budget are recorded in the audit log.
years.label: Name
years.budgetHint: The total the club can spend this year.
years.emptyHint: Create one to start accepting expenses.

public.title: Public page
public.description: A read-only dashboard anyone can open, for donors and sponsors.
public.whatsShown: Shows the budget, totals and breakdowns. Never receipts, names, shops or private notes.

members.title: Members
members.count: {count, plural, one {# active member} other {# active members}}
members.addHint: They'll sign in with a code sent to this email. No password needed.
members.emailFixed: To change the email, remove this member and add the new address.
members.name: Name
members.nameHint: Shown to other members on the dashboard. Never shown publicly.
members.memberHint: Can submit expenses and see the dashboard.
members.adminHint: Can also review expenses, pay members back and manage everything here.
members.removeHint: They'll be signed out and can't sign in again. Their expenses stay on record, and you can restore them later.

options.nameZhHint: Leave empty to use the English name.
options.used: {count, plural, =0 {Not used yet} one {Used once} other {Used # times}}

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: What the money was spent on. Archived categories stay on old expenses.

events.title: Events
events.description: Charity sales and other activities expenses can be tied to.

submit.title: New expense
submit.receiptsHint: Add one screenshot per payment. The amount, shop and date fill in by themselves; check them before submitting.
submit.receiptsEditHint: Check the details against the screenshot. You can add or replace photos.
submit.addScreenshotsHint: WeChat Pay, Alipay or a photo of the receipt. You can pick several at once.
submit.duplicateExact: This screenshot has already been submitted
submit.duplicateSimilar: This looks like a receipt that was already submitted
submit.duplicateOwn: It matches expense #{id}. Remove it unless this really is a separate payment.
submit.duplicateHint: You can still submit it; the reviewer will see this warning.
submit.detailsShared: These apply to every payment above.
submit.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Flour and butter for the bake sale
submit.descriptionHint: Shown on the public page, so don't include anyone's name.
submit.addNote: Add a private note for the reviewer
submit.noteHint: Only you and admins can see this.
submit.itemCount: {count, plural, =0 {No payments yet} one {# payment} other {# payments}}
submit.submitted: {count, plural, one {Expense submitted} other {# expenses submitted}}
submit.noYearHint: The club lead needs to set up this year's budget first.

errors.future: The date can't be in the future.
errors.noYear: This date isn't in any budget year.

uploadErrors.too_large: This image is too large (15 MB max).
uploadErrors.unsupported: This file isn't an image we can read. Try a screenshot or JPEG.
uploadErrors.rate_limited: Too many uploads. Wait a while and try again.
uploadErrors.unauthorized: You've been signed out. Sign in again.
uploadErrors.network: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

expenses.title: My expenses
expenses.description: Everything you've submitted and where it's at.
expenses.emptyHint: Bought something for the club? Add the payment screenshot and you'll be paid back once it's approved.

expense.title: Expense #{id}
expense.awaitingPayback: Approved. You'll be paid back soon.
expense.withdrawHint: It will be removed before anyone reviews it. You can submit it again later.

duplicates.title: Possible double claim
duplicates.exact: The same screenshot is attached to <ref>#{id}</ref>.
duplicates.similar: A near-identical screenshot with the same amount is attached to <ref>#{id}</ref>.
duplicates.details: Same amount, shop and date as <ref>#{id}</ref>.
duplicates.earlier: The same screenshot was submitted before and later withdrawn.

review.rejectHint: The member sees this reason and can fix the expense and resubmit it.
review.voidHint: It stays on record with your reason, but no longer counts towards spending. Use this only to correct a mistake.

reviewQueue.title: Review
reviewQueue.summary: {count, plural, one {# expense} other {# expenses}} waiting · {total}
reviewQueue.emptyHint: New submissions will show up here.

reimburse.title: Pay back
reimburse.description: Members who paid for approved expenses themselves.
reimburse.summary: {total} owed to {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}
reimburse.owedHint: Approved expenses that haven't been paid back yet.
reimburse.nobodyOwedHint: Approved expenses show up here until they're paid back.
reimburse.payHint: Send the money first, then record it here with the transfer screenshot.
reimburse.selectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {None selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}
reimburse.transferHint: The WeChat or Alipay transfer to the member. Visible only to admins and that member.
reimburse.noAmountFound: Couldn't read an amount. Check it matches the total.
reimburse.amountMismatch: The screenshot shows {found} but the selected total is {total}. Check before confirming.
reimburse.permanent: Reimbursements are permanent and can't be edited afterwards.
